evidence_type: maintainer-reported sanitized post-fix Bug Hunter regression summary

evidence_provenance.source: Maintainer's local real-Hermes execution report, also recorded in PR #2
evidence_provenance.scope: Summary only; raw checkpoint and summary remain local and Git-ignored. This public summary does not independently reproduce or regrade the raw model outputs.

execution.preflight_observation: The first launch stopped before any task invocation or checkpoint because hermes --version exceeded the evaluator's 10-second timeout during an update check. After the update cache existed, the same evaluation settings completed all 30 planned invocations.

changes_under_evaluation: Generic complete buggy candidate example and explicit required source-location fields in the Bug Hunter skill
Allowed type and severity values in the skill and validator rejection messages
Whole-candidate review after validation errors, with strict rejection retained and no enum coercion
limits: The same 10 known public synthetic tasks were used before and after the fix; this is regression evidence, not held-out generalization.
The original complete evaluation remains 114/120 (95%). The original other-skill results are not combined with these 30 post-fix runs.
Three repeats of a task are correlated; this is not 30 independent tasks.
The requested model and provider label are metadata, not backend identity attestation.
Recorded latency includes agent execution and local grading, not model-only latency.
First-candidate success, internal candidate submission counts, token cost, and automatic proof of designated tool calls remain unmeasured.
The two guidance/feedback changes were evaluated together; there was no separate ablation or comparison with a no-skill agent.
